verdict.rationale: Chronicle is an agent evaluation and observability platform, so alerting is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence shows observability and a claim of 'real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback.' Nothing documents configurable alert rules on error rates, cost spikes or eval-score drops, or notification delivery to Slack, PagerDuty or email. The Slack mention refers to simulated records loaded into test worlds, not alert delivery.
